title: Special Lok Adalat 2024 — Official Supreme Court Message (English)
description: An official message on the Special Lok Adalat initiative, originally published by the Supreme Court of India. External educational resource, not a video by this law office.
content:
## Official court educational resource

This is a publicly linked video from the **Supreme Court of India** regarding the Special Lok Adalat initiative (2024). It is displayed for general public legal education with attribution.

## What viewers can learn

- What Lok Adalat means in dispute resolution.
- Why settlement pathways can be relevant to eligible matters.
- Why parties should verify the relevant court and current procedure.

**Publisher:** Supreme Court of India. This video does not imply endorsement of Advocate Dr. Vishnu Sharma.

## Video source and public guidance

The Court is the original publisher. The presentation provides general awareness and does not state that a settlement, legal aid or remedy is guaranteed in any individual proceeding. Check current eligibility, case listing procedures and the published notice before acting. For a time-sensitive matter, record the case number, court, dates, notice copies, and communications with counsel. Verify official details at the judiciary website instead of relying on a clip alone.
